dogecoin.text:
What a week! @Ankr and @DogeOS just teamed up for a massive infrastructure partnership! @DogeOS is the new app layer for @Dogecoin, and Ankr's RPC network ensures speed and reliability. 
Huge win for #Dogecoin builders! $ANKR $DOGE

By bridging Dogecoin's proven stability with modern smart contract capabilities, DogeOS opens up a whole new world of possibilities for its ecosystem. The future of Dogecoin dApps starts now!
#Ankr #DogeOS #Dogecoin #Web3 #EVM #dApps

DogeOS will become the EVM-compatible application layer on top of Dogecoin. This empowers developers to deploy smart contracts and build decentralized applications, all while leveraging Dogecoin's inherent security and widespread adoption. #ANKR
What exactly is DogeOS? It's an EVM-based application layer for the Dogecoin network. Built on Scroll’s architecture with key modifications, it's designed for scalability and efficiency. #ANKR

Developers looking to build advanced dApps on Dogecoin can now leverage DogeOS through Ankr's Public and Premium RPCs. Get ready for seamless request calls and information returns, just like running your own node!
#ANKR

🧵 Ankr x DogeOS: Bringing dApp Development to the Dogecoin Ecosystem!

We're thrilled to announce that DogeOS is now available on @Ankr's Web3 API service! This is massive news for developers and the entire Dogecoin community. 👇
